title: fix(objectql): a roll-up recompute stamps the master as the system, not the child's writer
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbTGhxJSYAmQXU7efVdNqrpw)_

Fixes #33950

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none (runtime audit stamping; no authorable key changes; the dev confirms against the diff)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：子记录增删改或换父记录触发汇总字段重算时，主记录的「修改人」记为系统（`updated_by = null`，界面显示「系统」），「修改时间」刷新；不再记成写子记录的人。
- 为什么改：按裁决「记为系统并刷新时间」。原来财务只录了一张发票，合同就显示「最后修改人：财务」，审计记录误导。
- 风险与回滚：只改汇总重算这一次主记录写入的审计戳；用户直接改主记录、写子记录本身照旧记本人；主记录上的钩子和流程仍知道是谁触发的。回滚即回退本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts`（审计戳钩子里新增的系统分支），`packages/objectql/src/engine-summaries-and-expansion.ts`（重算写入带上引擎内部标记）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/engine-summary-recompute-audit-actor.test.ts`，预期 5 个用例全绿（插入/修改/删除/换父 + 对照）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`recomputeSummaries` writes a child's roll-up onto the master through an ordinary engine `update`, under a `sudo()`-shaped context (`{ ...caller, isSystem: true }`). The caller's `userId` rides that context on purpose, so the master's hooks and record-triggered flows still know who triggered the write. The `sys_stamp_audit_update` hook read the same `userId` and stamped it into the master's `updated_by`.

- `engine-summaries-and-expansion.ts`: the master update now carries `SUMMARY_RECOMPUTE_WRITE`, an engine-only `Symbol.for` option key. It reaches only that one update: the master's hooks keep the caller's context, and a write a hook issues through `ctx.api` carries the context, not this options bag. No door can build it from a request: `rejectUnknownEngineOptions` reads string keys only, and JSON carries no symbols. `WRITE_PRECONDITION_OPTION` already uses this precedent.
- `plugin.ts`: the update stamp reads the key off `input.options`. When it is present, it stamps `updated_by = null` (ADR-0118 D1, only when the object has the column) and a fresh `updated_at`, whoever the session is. Every other write stamps exactly as before.

A child insert, update and delete, and a re-parent (both the old and the new master), all reach the master through this one write.

Ruling recorded on the card (comment 6902001862): 「确定汇总字段自动重算时主记录的修改人和修改时间怎么记」 → 「记为系统并刷新时间」.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/engine-summary-recompute-audit-actor.test.ts` boots the real `ObjectQLPlugin` stamp hook over a fake driver. It has rows for child insert, update, delete and re-parent (both masters) by user B on a master that user A last edited. Each asserts `updated_by === null` and a refreshed `updated_at`. CONTROL: B's direct edit of the master still stamps B.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/summary-recompute-system-stamp.dogfood.test.ts` runs a real showcase boot (SQL driver, the app's own security profile, `AuditPlugin`). A signed-up member, who may create `showcase_task` but is refused a PATCH of `showcase_project`, adds a task. The project's `task_count` moves, its `updated_by` is `null`, `updated_at` moves, and no `sys_audit_log` row on the project names the member. CONTROL: the admin's own PATCH stamps the admin.

## Acceptance notes

- Field history: the CRUD audit writer already drops summary-only updates, because `diff()` skips computed field types and the audit noise fields. So a recompute writes no ledger row at all. The dogfood pin asserts that no row on the master names the child writer.
- The hook-level `runAs: 'system'` rule ("elevation is not anonymity, `updated_by` still names the operator") is unchanged. This PR scopes the system stamp to the recompute's own write, not to `isSystem` writes in general.
- The `engine.ts` docblock on `ScopedRepo.execute` elevation still says `recomputeSummaries`'s `systemCtx` stamps `updated_by` from `userId`. That file is outside this card's file surface, so the sentence is left as is. It is now stale for the recompute only.
- `backfillSummaryNulls` (`os migrate summary-nulls`) is a separate one-off writer and is not touched.

## Verification

Readings were taken at `f89df01cd3` (same source as the head, before the `origin/main` merge and the double's bound fix). Every run went through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`.

<details><summary>Unit pin: green, then ablated red, then restored</summary>

- Green: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/engine-summary-recompute-audit-actor.test.ts` gave `Tests 5 passed (5)` (VERDICT command-exit 0).
- Ablation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor `{ context: systemCtx, [SUMMARY_RECOMPUTE_WRITE]: true } as any` replaced by `{ context: systemCtx } as any`. This is the recompute write as it stands on `origin/main`. The mutation landed (anchor 1 to 0). Result: `Tests 4 failed | 1 passed (5)`. Insert, update, delete and re-parent each failed with `expected 'u_child_writer_b' to be null`, and the CONTROL passed. This also re-measures the card's premise on main: the child writer is stamped on the master.
- Restore: blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

<details><summary>Dogfood pin (real driver, dist): green, then ablated red, then restored</summary>

- Green after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build`: `Tests 3 passed (3)`.
- Ablation of the hook's read in `plugin.ts`: `hookCtx?.input?.options?.[SUMMARY_RECOMPUTE_WRITE] === true` was replaced by a never-true marker expression, then `@objectstack/objectql` was rebuilt. `ablation-dist-preflight` reported the marker present in 2 built files. Result: `Tests 1 failed | 2 passed (3)`, with `expected 'Cn8RZN9WCVK0GCCNpkmfRXg6YsOd4y1m' to be null`: the member's id was stamped on the project.
- Restore leg: blob equal to HEAD, then a rebuild. Preflight `--absent` found the marker absent from all 14 built files, and the run was back to `Tests 3 passed (3)`.
- The first ablation attempt was a no-op. Its replacement left `hookCtx` unread, so the DTS build failed (TS6133) and the suite never ran. It was redone with the expression above.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates (dispatch-gates --commands, derived for this diff)</summary>

76 derived commands were run locally, each with its exit code captured before any pipe.

- All exited 0 except the three below.
- `check:objectql-double-limit` first found the new test's driver double limit-blind. The double now applies the caller's bound after the filter and before the row copy, and the gate reads `OK` (754 graded, none new).
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: PREREQUISITE NOT MET. It needs `dist/` of packages outside this diff's closure. NOT MEASURED locally; CI runs it.
- `check:type-check-debt`: PREREQUISITE NOT MET. Its closure build never got a turn on the shared lock. NOT MEASURED locally; CI runs it.

</details>

<details><summary>Declared narrowing: objectql typecheck and full suite go to CI</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test` were queued on the shared verify lock four times. Each attempt ended `queue-timeout (exit 99)` behind a sibling's full dogfood battery, which held the lock for over 50 minutes. NOT MEASURED locally: `TypeScript Type Check` and `Test Core` on this PR carry them.

No public export of `@objectstack/objectql` changes: the new symbol is not re-exported from `index.ts` or `core.ts`. So importers owe no tests of their own (the os-dev local-scope rule). `git merge-tree` against `origin/main`, #33887 and #33652 (the open PRs in neighbouring objectql files) is clean. No open PR touches either source file this PR edits.

</details>
